summary: VisionWave Holdings filed an 8-K reporting an Assignment of Exchange Rights, Joinder and Partial Satisfaction of Note Agreement with Adrian Holdings S.R.L. The Company assigned to Adrian its right to receive 14.84 billion SaverOne ordinary shares from a prior Exchange Agreement, directly reducing the $10M Adrian Note principal upon each closing. The assignment is structured as a conduit, with title passing directly to Adrian. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation was disclosed. What to watch: remaining note balance and regulatory details of the share issuance.
